notes.subject: חוקך
notes.rationale: Kethib 'חוקך' i gat klostu mining 'bel/susut bilong yu'; planti man i rit 'הוקך' — 'em i stap long insait'

notes.subject: ⟨ol⟩ long ken long כלה
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat 'ol' — ol birua bilong ves 10 i stap long tingting tasol

notes.subject: תשיב ידך
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'yu givim bek han bilong yu' — potensel bilong pait i stap bek; Tok Pisin i tok 'holim bek'

notes.subject: long Elohim
notes.rationale: Askim i go stret long Elohim — toktok bilong skrim long em

translation: Bilong wanem yu holim bek ⟨את⟩ han bilong yu, ⟨na⟩ han sut bilong yu? Pulim em i kam ausait long bel bilong yu, na pinisim ⟨ol⟩.
